findings.issue: goto(url, { noScroll: true, keepFocus: true, replace: true }) uses options removed in SvelteKit 3 (replaced by the single reset option); they are silently ignored, so changing the game resets scroll and steals focus from the select, jumping the user away from the Moves section when the URL has no #hash
findings.suggestion: Use goto(url, { replace: true, reset: false }) — the current API, which is exactly what the two removed options expressed

findings.issue: The root error page renders 'Not found' for every error, including 500s from a failed upstream PokeAPI request (getJson throws on non-ok responses)
findings.suggestion: Read page.status (or the error prop from $app/state) and render a generic error message for non-404 statuses; keep 'Not found' only for 404

findings.issue: Filter state is mirrored into local $state and re-synced only on popstate via navigation.to.url; for shallow history entries page.url is deliberately not updated by SvelteKit, so this sync depends on subtle navigation internals, and an invalid ?type/?generation on back/forward clears the UI without fixing the URL
findings.suggestion: Prefer deriving filter state reactively from page.shallow?.url ?? page.url (the documented source of truth for shallow entries) instead of the afterNavigate mirror

findings.issue: {#key data.selectedGame} resets MoveTable sort state only when the selected game name changes; navigating between two Pokémon that share the same default game keeps the previous sort/direction applied to the new tables
findings.suggestion: Key on the Pokémon name as well (e.g. {#key `${data.heading}:${data.selectedGame}`}) so per-Pokémon table state resets on same-route navigation

findings.issue: The module-level promise cache has no eviction or TTL; fine for this fixed snapshot, but it is hidden global state whose growth characteristics a maintainer must reason about
findings.suggestion: Document the caching assumption (bounded by the fixed dataset) next to the Map, or add a simple size cap

findings.issue: isMissing is duplicated verbatim in three files and format in two, so a future tweak (e.g. treating 0 as missing) must be made three times
findings.suggestion: Move isMissing and the em-dash formatter into #lib/format.js and import them everywhere

findings.issue: humanize is re-exported from the server data module while components import it from #lib/format.js, creating two import paths for the same helper
findings.suggestion: Drop the re-export and import from #lib/format.js at each use site

findings.issue: class: directives are used in several components, where current official skill guidance prefers clsx-style class values
findings.suggestion: Replace class:has-types / class:missing / class:type-tile with class={[...]} or object syntax (e.g. class={{ missing: isMissing(row.power) }})

summary: A genuinely current, well-structured SvelteKit 3 codebase: Vite-plugin config, the new #lib import map, $app/state, shallow-routing goto, the new error() signature, and clean runes/snippets throughout, with a tidy server/client boundary in lib/server. The one framework slip is a goto() call using options removed in SvelteKit 3, which silently resets scroll/focus when changing the selected game. I'd merge after a small round of nits: that fix, a status-aware +error page, and deduplication of a couple of tiny helpers.
